create_CannyProcessor: create a CannyProcessor instance with output names and optional device for edge detection
run_CannyProcessor_forward_image: run the CannyProcessor forward method on a PIL image to obtain edge detection output
run_CannyProcessor_forward_tensor: run the CannyProcessor forward method on a 3D, 4D, or 5D torch tensor to obtain edge detection
run_CannyProcessor_forward_image_list: run the CannyProcessor forward method on a list of PIL images to obtain batch edge detection
test_CannyProcessor: test the CannyProcessor class handles PIL images, tensors, and image lists correctly
